near_misses.question: What is the monthly price of the Team plan?
near_misses.answer: We do not offer a Team plan — our plans are Starter ($29), Growth ($79), Pro ($149), and Enterprise (custom).
near_misses.note: No Team plan exists; resembles the plan-price questions.

near_misses.question: What is the API rate limit on the Enterprise plan?
near_misses.answer: Enterprise API limits are set per contract — contact sales.
near_misses.note: No Enterprise limit in the knowledge base; resembles q05/q06.

near_misses.question: How do I downgrade my plan?
near_misses.answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan and pick a lower plan. The downgrade applies at the end of the billing period.
near_misses.note: Downgrade is a different action from upgrade/cancel.

near_misses.question: How many team seats does the Growth plan include?
near_misses.answer: The Growth plan includes 10 team seats.
near_misses.note: Growth seats are not in the knowledge base; resembles q11/q12.

near_misses.question: How fast is support on the Growth plan?
near_misses.answer: Growth support responds within 8 business hours.
near_misses.note: Growth support time is not in the knowledge base; resembles q14/q15.

near_misses.question: What is the annual price of the Starter plan?
near_misses.answer: Starter is $29 per month; paid annually it is $278.40 per year after the 20% discount.
near_misses.note: Only the monthly price is cached; annual price must be computed.

near_misses.question: What is the uptime SLA on the Starter plan?
near_misses.answer: There is no uptime SLA on the Starter plan — the 99.9% SLA applies to Pro and Enterprise.
near_misses.note: Shares uptime/SLA tokens with q18 but the answer is the opposite.

near_misses.question: Is SSO with SAML available on the Starter plan?
near_misses.answer: No — SSO with SAML is available on Pro and Enterprise only.
near_misses.note: Shares SSO/SAML tokens with q13 but the answer is No.

near_misses.question: Are audit logs available on the Pro plan?
near_misses.answer: No — audit logs are available on the Enterprise plan only.
near_misses.note: Shares audit-log tokens with q21 but the answer is No.

near_misses.question: How long is data kept after I upgrade?
near_misses.answer: Upgrading does not delete data — data is kept for 90 days only after cancellation.
near_misses.note: Mixes retention with upgrade; no such cached entry.

near_misses.question: What is the free trial for the Enterprise plan?
near_misses.answer: Enterprise trials are arranged with sales — the self-serve 14-day trial includes Growth features.
near_misses.note: Shares trial tokens with q10 but Enterprise trials differ.

near_misses.question: Can I export my data as JSON?
near_misses.answer: Exports are CSV only — JSON export is not available.
near_misses.note: Shares export tokens with q16 but the answer is No.
